Method of Attack: Information-stealing malware (W4SP Stealer) stealing passwords, Discord authentication cookies, and cryptocurrency wallets
Impacted Systems: Web browsers (Google Chrome, Opera, Brave Browser, Yandex Browser, Microsoft Edge)
Discord clients (Discord, Discord PTB, Discord Canary, LightCord)
The Nations Glory online game cookies
Attack Vector: Malicious packages uploaded to PyPI repository
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Discord webhook to upload stolen data
Functions checking for keywords related to banking, passwords, PayPal, cryptocurrency, multi-factor authentication
Use of transfer.sh file transfer service for exfiltration
Keywords in French indicating possible threat actor origin
